claims.statement: Management expects store additions to be around 40 to 50 stores in the near term, with potential to increase to 60 or 70 stores per year in another two to three years.
claims.quote: We are primed and ready in terms of opening around 40-50 stores. I mean anything between that is what we are ready and we will deliver broadly... in another two to three years, this 40 should go to a 60 or a 70 per year.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets new store openings to be approximately 10% to 15% of the total store count annually.
claims.quote: I've been saying this repeatedly that typically 10% to 15% of my number count should be my new store opening, broadly. That's the way we think about it.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects general merchandise and apparel (GMA) contribution trend line to remain around the current run rate of about 23%.
claims.quote: A broad trend line will be around the current run rates of around 23%, is the sense we get.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company delivered 30.3 crores bill cuts in the fiscal year.
facts.quote: We delivered 30.3 crores bill cuts in the year just gone by.

facts.statement: Like-for-like growth for stores open for more than 24 months was 9.9%.
facts.quote: Like-for-like growth that we disclosed is for stores which are open for more than at least 24 months. We delivered 9.9% like-for-like growth.

facts.statement: Total retail business area at the end of fiscal '24 was about 15.1 million square feet.
facts.quote: The total retail business area at the end of the fiscal '24 was about 15.1 million square feet.

facts.statement: Standalone revenue from operations was INR49,533 crores in FY24.
facts.quote: Moving on, the revenue from operations as disclosed earlier is INR49,533 crores, delivered in the stand-alone business.

facts.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin was 8.3%, generating almost INR4,100 crores of EBITDA.
facts.quote: EBITDA margin of 8.3%, so almost INR4,100 crores of EBITDA.

facts.statement: Standalone PAT was INR2,695 crores, representing a 5.4% PAT margin.
facts.quote: We delivered 5.4% PAT, about INR2,695 crores.

facts.statement: Net cash flow from operations was INR3,343 crores.
facts.quote: And the net cash flow from operations of INR3,343 crores.

facts.statement: Equity stands at approximately INR19,281 crores.
facts.quote: and the equity is about INR19,281 crores.
